envelope.description: Add callTool and the compile-time guard

body.title: Add callTool and the compile-time guard
body.summary: Add TypedTool, TypedToolResult and callTool in the tools module: callTool takes the tool definition, types its input as Static of inputSchema and its data as Static of outputSchema, calls executeTool and returns a ToolFailure on any failure without throwing. Add src/daemon/tools/call-tool.type-test.ts, compiled by npm run build, with @ts-expect-error lines proving that a tool without an outputSchema and a wrongly typed input do not compile.
acceptanceChecks: data is typed from the output schema with no cast
callTool does not compile for a tool with no outputSchema
a failure result has no data and a ToolFailure with a kind
npm run build passes with the type-test file

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.test.ts: the runtime values of the fake definitions are what the types say
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.test.ts: TypedToolResult data is absent when success is false
